_read_me: Your repricing rules. Change a number, save, and run the repricer again. Lines starting with _ are notes.

fees._note: eBay's standard rate for most categories is 13.6% of the total sale + a per-order fee. Check yours in Seller Hub > Payments > Reports > Transaction report and change these if they differ.
fees._tax_note: eBay charges its fee on the sales tax too. 6 is Michigan's rate, a middle-of-the-road guess for buyers nationwide.
fees._shipping_note: If you offer free shipping, put your average label cost here so the floor covers it.

_profit_note: The lowest price ever suggested covers cost + eBay fees + this much profit ($3 matches the sale tier report), and is never under min_price.
_tiers_note: How much to cut from the ORIGINAL price once a listing has been up this many days. These match the sale tier report built from your own sales (Nov 2026): 10% at 79 days, 20% at 107, 30% at 160. Bigger cuts = faster sales.
_watchers_note: Listings with at least this many watchers get the next-smaller cut. Send those watchers an offer instead.
_slow_lane_note: Titles with these words sell well for you, so they wait one tier longer before a cut.
_min_change_note: Skip changes smaller than this many dollars.
